items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: So we're in this nice hotel... I have something real funny. So we're in this nice hotel

ctx.x: Pierre Tallerie. here's Oh, I have something real funny. So we're in this nice hotel, a beautiful hotel. So I'm getting ready to go to bed and I see the wall. They had a hole in the wall over my head. I didn't pay any attention, you know. A nice hotel, you never think of nothing bad.

So almost -- I was getting ready to go to bed, and I see this big old thing coming through this hole, and I'm half stoned, so I got sober so fast. I got my clothes on so fast, was out there so fast -- out that room that is. Down in the lobby, I said, "They got a big animal up in my room." They said, "What is it?" I said, "About that long." "Oh," they said, "that's nothing. That's a lizard." I said, "What do you mean that's nothing, it's a lizard?" They said, "You ought to be happy he's in your room." I said,…
